title: Why We Shouldn’t Fear AI in Healthcare

reader_summary.headline: Why We Shouldn't Fear the Black Box of AI in Healthcare and Everywhere by Vijay.
reader_summary.overview: Why We Shouldn't Fear the Black Box of AI in Healthcare and Everywhere by Vijay. This article first appeared in the New York Times in January 2018. You can also find and share it at A6.Z.com slash AI doctor.

key_points.text: Artificial intelligence is black box is nothing to fear.
key_points.evidence_quote: Artificial intelligence is black box is nothing to fear.

key_points.text: So alongside the excitement and hype about our growing reliance on artificial intelligence, there's a fear about the way the technology works.
key_points.evidence_quote: So alongside the excitement and hype about our growing reliance on artificial intelligence, there's a fear about the way the technology works.

key_points.text: A recent MIT Tech Review article, titled The Dark Secret at the Heart of AI.
key_points.evidence_quote: A recent MIT Tech Review article, titled The Dark Secret at the Heart of AI, warned that no one really knows how the most advanced algorithms do what they do, and that could be a problem.

key_points.text: Thanks to this uncertainty and lack of accountability, a report by the AI Now Institute recommended that public agencies responsible for criminal justice.
key_points.evidence_quote: Thanks to this uncertainty and lack of accountability, a report by the AI Now Institute recommended that public agencies responsible for criminal justice, health care, welfare, and education shouldn't even use such technology.
